items.source: RuntimeException - in case of errors; will be logged but not propagated (note: do not throw TransactionException subclasses here!)
items.translation: RuntimeException - 在发生错误时；将记录日志但不传播 （注意：此处不要抛出 TransactionException 的子类！）

items.source: TransactionSynchronization implementations can implement the Ordered interface to influence their execution order. A synchronization that does not implement the Ordered interface is appended to the end of the synchronization chain.
items.translation: TransactionSynchronization 实现可以实现Ordered接口以影响其执行顺序。未实现Ordered接口的同步会被追加到同步链的末尾。

items.source:
System synchronizations performed by Spring itself use specific order values,
allowing for fine-grained interaction with their execution order (if necessary).
items.translation: Spring 自身执行的系统同步使用特定的顺序值，以便在必要时对其执行顺序进行细粒度交互。

items.source: Completion status in case of proper commit.
items.translation: 正确提交情况下的完成状态。

items.source: Completion status in case of proper rollback.
items.translation: 正常回滚情况下的完成状态。

items.source: Completion status in case of heuristic mixed completion or system errors.
items.translation: 在启发式混合完成或系统错误情况下的完成状态。

items.source: RuntimeException - in case of errors; will be propagated to the caller (note: do not throw TransactionException subclasses here!)
items.translation: RuntimeException - 在发生错误时；将传播给调用者(注意：此处不要抛出 TransactionException 的子类！)

items.source: NOTE: The transaction will have been committed already, but the transactional resources might still be active and accessible. As a consequence, any data access code triggered at this point will still "participate" in the original transaction, allowing to perform some cleanup (with no commit following anymore!), unless it explicitly declares that it needs to run in a separate transaction. Hence: Use PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW for any transactional operation that is called from here.
items.translation: 注意： 事务可能已经提交，但事务性资源可能仍然处于活动状态并可访问。因此，在此时触发的任何数据访问代码仍会“参与”原始事务，从而允许执行一些清理操作（而不再进行提交！），除非它明确声明需要在独立的事务中运行。因此：对于从此处调用的任何事务性操作，请使用 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW。

items.source: NOTE: The transaction will have been committed or rolled back already, but the transactional resources might still be active and accessible. As a consequence, any data access code triggered at this point will still "participate" in the original transaction, allowing to perform some cleanup (with no commit following anymore!), unless it explicitly declares that it needs to run in a separate transaction. Hence: Use PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW for any transactional operation that is called from here.
items.translation: 注意：此时事务可能已经提交或回滚，但事务性资源可能仍然处于活动状态并可访问。因此，在此时触发的任何数据访问代码仍会“参与”原始事务，从而允许执行一些清理操作（而不再进行后续提交！），除非它明确声明需要在独立的事务中运行。因此：对于从此处调用的任何事务性操作，请使用 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW。

items.source: This method will be invoked after beforeCommit, even when beforeCommit threw an exception. This callback allows for closing resources before transaction completion, for any outcome.
items.translation: 此方法将在 `beforeCommit` 之后被调用，即使 `beforeCommit` 抛出了异常。此回调允许在事务完成前的任何结果下关闭资源。

items.source: This callback does not mean that the transaction will actually be committed. A rollback decision can still occur after this method has been called. This callback is rather meant to perform work that's only relevant if a commit still has a chance to happen, such as flushing SQL statements to the database.
items.translation: 此回调并不意味着事务实际上会被提交。在此方法调用之后仍可能发生回滚决策。此回调主要用于执行仅在提交仍有发生机会时才相关的工作，例如将 SQL 语句刷新到数据库。

items.source:
Note that exceptions will get propagated to the commit caller and cause a
rollback of the transaction.
items.translation: 注意，异常将传播到提交调用者并导致事务回滚。

items.source:
Can, for example, commit further operations that are supposed to follow on a successful
commit of the main transaction, like confirmation messages or emails.
items.translation: 例如，可以提交应在主事务成功提交后执行的进一步操作，如确认消息或电子邮件。

items.source: Invoked after transaction commit.
items.translation: 事务提交后调用。

items.source: Invoked after transaction commit/rollback.
items.translation: 在事务提交/回滚后调用。

items.source: Invoked before transaction commit (before "beforeCompletion").
items.translation: 在事务提交之前调用（在"beforeCompletion"之前）。

items.source: Invoked before transaction commit/rollback.
items.translation: 事务提交/回滚前调用。

items.source: Resume this synchronization.
items.translation: 恢复此同步。

items.source: Suspend this synchronization.
items.translation: 挂起此同步。

items.source:
Suspend this synchronization.
Supposed to unbind resources from TransactionSynchronizationManager if managing any.
items.translation: 挂起此同步。如果管理任何资源，则应从 TransactionSynchronizationManager 解绑这些资源。

items.source:
Resume this synchronization.
Supposed to rebind resources to TransactionSynchronizationManager if managing any.
items.translation: 恢复此同步。如果管理任何资源，应重新绑定到 TransactionSynchronizationManager。

items.source: status - completion status according to the STATUS_* constants
items.translation: status - 根据 STATUS_* 常量确定的完成状态

items.translation: readOnly - 事务是否定义为只读事务
